standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.npc: Hello! The name's Kit. Sir Kit Breaker.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.player: Sir Kit? That's a nice name!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.npc: Thank you! I chose it myself!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.player: ... Thinking about it, I chose mine as well. I'm [player name], by the way.
What do you do around here?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-did-not-.npc: I'm helping Gilbert with a project of his, on behalf of the White knights. It will take us a while but I can let you know when we're closer to completion!

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.npc: [player name], it's good to see you.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.player: How are you getting on as a White Knight?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.npc: It's going well, thank you. Being on loan to Gilbert and the Glade project is giving me good purpose whilst I do all the basic training.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.player: Gilbert's not working you too hard is he?

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-complete.npc: Not yet at least, until we get started on the land. For now it's mostly tending to the flowers and wandering... Patrolling around!
I can't thank you enough, [player name]. I hope you'll pop by one day as the Glade project progresses. Don't be a stranger!
